name: JSON Formatter
description: Pretty-print, minify or validate JSON text.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.

hints.input: The tool keeps the original order of object keys; duplicate keys are reported as invalid instead of being silently overwritten.
hints.action: Validate only reports whether the syntax is legal; it does not rewrite the content.
hints.indent: The indent width is measured in spaces; 2, 4 and 8 are available.
hints.sortKeys: Sorting only affects the key order of objects; array order never changes.
hints.escapeUnicode: Escaping turns Chinese and other characters into \uXXXX form, which is handy for environments that only accept ASCII.
hints.output: Format re-indents with the chosen width; minify removes every unnecessary whitespace character.

faq.a: A standard JSON parser lets the later key win, and a duplicate key is almost always a typo, so the tool reports an error instead of silently dropping data.
The original order is preserved by default. Only enabling sort keys reorders object keys; array order is always kept.
No. Numbers are parsed as their original literal, so values beyond the JavaScript safe integer range are emitted unchanged.
